reviews.comment: Discussion, open book quiz, and lab each week. Group project for final. Long lecture videos and lots of reading. Labs are horrible. The required textbook and instruction videos are not updated, making them unusable. Lab instructions are confusing. Have to teach yourself. Slow grader. No communication. Only recommend for those with GIS experience.

This professor simply does not know how to teach nor accurately assess the student's understanding of the course. If you look at the grade distributions, I have never seen such a terrible array where out of like 12 people in a class, the professor gave half the class an F. At that point, they should think if they are ruining normal students lives.

I've taken Dr Chi twice, in person and online. In person she slowly reads her slides verbatim, and her online exams this semester were appalling. She makes many errors when preparing them, which makes them more difficult. Homework is whatever, and Lab is easily the best part of the class. This is a great course made OK by a bad professor.

One of the worst profs I've ever had. Her slides don't seem to be her own and she just reads straight off them. She lets you have a cheat sheet on exams but she made the exam harder because of it. I always went to class and could barely retain any info. Lab was somehow better than lecture and easier to understand.
